LanguageData.FlatBlack_SettingsIntro: Changes apply immediately and are shared across saves.
LanguageData.FlatBlack_Unavailable: Flat Black could not initialize. Check the game log for details.
LanguageData.FlatBlack_FontPresetTip: Choose vanilla fonts, or Oxanium headings with Exo 2 body text. Changes apply immediately. The game supplies fallback characters.
LanguageData.FlatBlack_BackgroundsTip: Use Flat Black backgrounds for windows, panels, buttons, tabs and menus.
LanguageData.FlatBlack_IconsTip: Use Flat Black interface icons, checkboxes and radio buttons. Health and status text colours remain unchanged.
LanguageData.FlatBlack_HighlightsTip: Theme selection highlights and separators. Health and warning colours keep their normal meaning.
LanguageData.FlatBlack_WindowOpacityTip: Opacity of themed windows. Panel and menu opacity is controlled separately.
LanguageData.FlatBlack_PanelOpacityTip: Opacity of themed panels, menus, buttons, tabs and tooltips. Window opacity is controlled separately.
LanguageData.FlatBlack_CustomAccentsTip: Replace red and purple theme accents with your chosen colours. Neutral and meaningful status colours are preserved.
LanguageData.FlatBlack_PrimaryAccentTip: Replaces red theme accents, including pressed buttons and selected options.
LanguageData.FlatBlack_ResetTip: Restore Oxanium + Exo 2 fonts, theme components, opacity and accent colours to their defaults.
